evidence_cards.why_suggested: Adds an overwintering rye cover crop to shorten bare periods (mock).
evidence: Runoff volume 1818.6 m³ vs 2433.1 m³ existing (25.0% less, modeled).
Bare soil about 15.5 days per year vs 198.0 (derived).
benefits: Soil is covered through the wettest months.
Less water collects in the low spot in this replay.
information_gaps: Cover crop establishment depends on planting date and weather.
risks_for_local_review: Ask a local agronomist about termination timing before the next crop.

evidence_cards.why_suggested: Adds a perennial alfalfa phase that keeps the ground covered for two years (mock).

benefits: Perennial cover protects the steeper slopes.

insights.title: Water reaches the low spot (mock)
insights.body: During this storm, water starts collecting in the bowl about a day in.
insights.why_it_matters: Standing water can harm roots and delay field work.
insights.tip: Consider asking a local agronomist whether a drainage check is worthwhile.

insights.title: Peak ponding (mock)
insights.body: Ponding peaks at about 171.9 cm under the existing rotation.
insights.why_it_matters: This is the moment the low spot is most at risk.
insights.tip: Compare this frame across rotations with the A/B view.

insights.title: Valley carries the most water (mock)
insights.body: Flow concentrates along the valley in the middle of the storm.
insights.tip: Consider keeping this line in permanent cover. Verify locally.

insights.title: Cover crop shortens bare periods (mock)
insights.body: Bare days drop from 198.0 to 15.5 per year with the rye cover.
insights.why_it_matters: Covered soil sheds less sediment in heavy rain.
insights.tip: Ask a local agronomist about rye seeding dates for this area.

insights.title: Forage phase lowers erosion share (mock)
insights.body: The high-risk share falls from 3.4% to 0.0% (relative).
insights.why_it_matters: Steeper parts of the field lose less soil.
insights.tip: Consider where a perennial phase fits your operation. Verify locally.

insights.title: Soil group is assumed (mock)
insights.body: Every cell uses hydrologic soil group B because no soil map was used.
insights.why_it_matters: Runoff could be higher or lower on real soils.
insights.tip: If you know your soil type, compare it against group B with a local advisor.
